newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RESEARCH ALERT-ABN AMRO ups Richter 97/98 forecast.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ABN AMRO ups Richter 97/98 forecast.

text.p: ABN AMRO Hoare Govett upgraded its 1997 and 1998 earnings forecast for Richter Gedeon Rt saying that the Hungarian pharmaceuticals company's first quarter results were far above market expectations.

"We continue to forecast conservatively," said Tommy Erdei, Budapest-based analyst at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in a desknote, adding that the securities house maintained its "buy" recommendation for Richter shares.
"Rather than extrapolating the most recent increases in growth, we have assumed that current levels of business, will, broadly, be maintained, which allows significant up-side to earnings," he said.
"This is especially true for the CIS which contributed the most to sales increases for the (first) quarter."

ABN AMRO Hoare Govett revised its net profit forecast for Richter to 15.998 billion forints in 1997 and 20.259 billion in 1998. In February the securities house forecast a net profit of 14.612 billion forints for 1997 and 19.287 billion for 1998.

Richter reported an IAS net profit of 4.997 billion forints for the first quarter of 1997 on sales of 12.801 billion, up from a net profit of 3.258 billion on sales of 9.419 billion in the same period of 1996.
The company's sales to the CIS grew 40.1 percent to $22.7 million.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Richter shares closed at 14,900 forints on Monday. On Tuesday on the SEAQ Richter was marked at $82.25, up from Friday's close of $81.75.
